metadata.name: Unayurved Label Design Patterns
metadata.description: Mathematical patterns extracted from finalized label designs across products and sizes. Used to inform new product label creation and standardization.

design_samples.notes: Reference design for coconut oil - all specs baseline
Reference design for rose water - all specs baseline

universal_rules.rule: Canvas dimensions scale proportionally by bottle size
Font size minimums by container size (hard floor - print legibility)
universal_rules.reason: Print resolution requirements; sizes below floor become illegible at label scale

universal_rules.rule: Body left margin is approximately 5-6% of canvas width
Regulatory/manufacturer info left margin matches body left margin
Page count is always 2 (front + back label)
universal_rules.reason: All Unayurved products require front and back label

product_specific_variations.coconut_oil: Positioned lower on back label (higher Y offset)
product_specific_variations.rose_water: Positioned similarly but with different text length
product_specific_variations.inference: Text length and layout drive position, not product type
Top bar color is UNIVERSAL, not product-specific

product_specific_variations.coconut_oil: Full nutrient list (coconut oil has macro content)
product_specific_variations.inference: Table structure adapts to product properties, not arbitrary variation

size_specific_patterns.observation: Not uniform; height shrinks less than width (taller aspect ratio for smaller bottles)
size_specific_patterns.implication: Cannot use single scale factor; apply per-axis scaling

size_specific_patterns.observation: More uniform than 200ml; aspect ratio changes less drastically
size_specific_patterns.implication: 100ml maintains proportions better than 200ml relative to 500ml

size_specific_patterns.pattern: As size decreases, font floor increases relative to canvas scale
size_specific_patterns.500ml: No floor (all fonts scale proportionally from reference)
size_specific_patterns.reason: Smaller physical labels need larger relative fonts for readability

back_label_sections.behavior: Fixed height, full width, always at top

back_label_sections.content: Product description (100% Pure, Steam Distilled, etc.)
back_label_sections.behavior: Scales with canvas, margins scale proportionally
Scales with canvas; column positions follow 0.813/0.678 scaling

back_label_sections.content: Manufactured by, Address, MRP, Mfg Date, USP, Country
back_label_sections.behavior: Always positioned in lower third of back label, left-aligned

back_label_sections.content: Product image (e.g., rose flower for rose water)
back_label_sections.position: Right side of back label, overlapping with nutrition/regulatory
back_label_sections.behavior: Image dimensions scale with canvas, but overflow is normal (bleed)

olive_oil.size_500ml: Use DAHX9sxCpt4 (rose water) as base reference - apply standardize-formatting to match spec
olive_oil.size_200ml: Resize 500ml olive design to 230×396, then standardize-formatting
olive_oil.size_100ml: Resize 500ml olive design to 192×302, then standardize-formatting
olive_oil.expected_patterns: Olive oil (like coconut) has nutritional content → similar table structure to coconut oil, not rose water

extraction_notes.data_source: Six finalized Canva designs (3 coconut oil, 3 rose water across 500/200/100ml)
extraction_notes.methodology: Analyzed canvas dimensions, scaling factors, element positioning, font sizes, color values
limitations: Only 2 products (coconut oil, rose water) - patterns may not generalize to all oils
No variation in language or regulatory requirements tested
No variation in ingredient count or nutrition table complexity tested
future_improvements: Add olive oil samples (3 sizes) to validate patterns
Add kalonji oil samples for comparison with high-cost ingredient
Document exact font names and weights used per section
Extract color palette completely (#hex values for all elements)
Record element-level positioning data from each design
